full.text:
* The first step is to gather materials like a wooden spindle and a tallow candle.  
* Cut the spindle to the desired length and shape it into a decorative base.  
* Apply a coat of paint to the spindle to give it a vibrant look.  
* Attach the tallow candle to the top of the spindle for a traditional weather vane.  
* Mount the weather vane on a pole and display it in the neighborhood newsletter.  
* The flue of the tallow candle was carefully sealed to prevent any smoke from escaping, ensuring a clean and safe display.  
* The flue of the weather vane also helped to keep the area cool during the summer months.  
* [song title] was chosen to reflect the spirit of the community, and [meeting time] will be held to discuss the new weather vane.  
* [shelf letter] is now marked with the name of the weather vane, and [jar label] contains the materials used in its creation.
